payload.title: Declarative RBAC policy-hook builder (role × action × resource-type matrix)
payload.description: The mechanism — a synchronous, tightening-only policy hook that evaluates a role × action × resource-type write matrix — is generic; only the matrix data is app-specific. Reference impl: ~/dev/aquariusyacht/apps/backend/src/domains/users/rbac.ts (WRITABLE_OBJECTS matrix + rbacDenyReason) wired in apps/backend/src/runtime/automation.ts:89. Ship a makeRbacPolicyHook(matrix) factory from @fricken/server so apps declare the matrix and get the hook. NOTE: do NOT lift the userId→role-by-string-convention (roleForUserId) — that is a Zavro demo placeholder, not framework. Relates to the authz model in FR-1/FR-5.
